title: Operari Runbook
description: Canonical YAML/JSON schema for a Operari runbook. Mirrors backend/src/runbook/yaml/runbook-spec.ts. Used by the editor for save-time validation, by the CLI for `operari lint`, and by VS Code via yaml.schemas to power autocomplete + inline diagnostics.

version.description: Schema version. Bump on breaking changes.

slug.description: Stable slug used by the CLI/SDK to reference this runbook (e.g. `deploy-frontend`).

name.description: Human-readable name shown in the editor and run history.

schedule.description: Cron expression. Five fields, standard syntax. Validated against the scheduler at save time.

vars.description: Variables exposed to every step at runtime via {{vars.foo}}. Values are arbitrary YAML — strings, numbers, objects, lists.

steps.description: Ordered list of runbook steps. At least one step is required.

id.description: Unique slug-cased id within the runbook (e.g. `deploy-canary`). Appears in logs, retries, and `operari resume --from <id>`.

type.description: Step type matching a registered executor. The curated catalog ships shell, http, approval, notify, wait, switch, loop, plus the operari.* prefixed integration steps. Unknown types fail at run time, not at save time, so custom executors registered at runtime are still valid here.

name.description: Human-readable label shown in the canvas and run timeline. Defaults to `id` if omitted.

enabled.description: Whether the step runs. Defaults to true; setting to false disables it without removing it from the YAML.

config.description: Type-specific configuration. The shape depends on the step `type`; the schema does not validate it because executors evolve independently.

runIf.description: Template expression evaluated before the step runs. Falsy → step is SKIPPED and execution continues. Mutually exclusive with `skipIf`; if both are set, `skipIf` wins.

skipIf.description: Inverse of `runIf`. Truthy → step is SKIPPED. Useful for `skip on dry-run` patterns.

next.description: Successor step id(s). Omit on the final step. Strings reference another step by id. The structured form preserves source/target port indexes for non-default branching.

position.description: Editor-only metadata. Preserved on round-trip but YAML authors should never write it by hand.

RetryPolicy.description: Per-step retry policy. Cross-cutting (every step type honours it) so it lives at the step level rather than inside `config`.

count.description: Extra attempts after the first failure (count: 3 ⇒ up to 4 total runs of the step).

backoff.description: Strategy for the wait between attempts. `fixed` waits `delayMs` between every retry; `exponential` doubles each retry up to `maxDelayMs`.

delayMs.description: Base delay in milliseconds. For exponential backoff this is the first delay.

maxDelayMs.description: Cap on backoff growth in milliseconds. Only meaningful for exponential backoff.

StepConnection.description: Explicit successor edge with port indexes. Use the bare-string form unless you need non-default ports.

fromPort.description: Source port index on this step. Defaults to 0.

toPort.description: Target port index on the destination step. Defaults to 0.
